messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy will likely remain in fragments, but broad erosion of personal anonymity through data collection is highly likely, Privacy
Consciousness copying by the early 2030s is extremely unlikely because mapping a brain at synaptic and molecular detail is far beyond current technology, Consciousness
Wireless internet coverage will probably expand widely, though universal seamless access everywhere on Earth is difficult due to power, bandwidth, and geography, Wireless
Electric transport will probably become dominant for passenger vehicles and short-distance logistics, but all transport eventually electric is less likely for long-haul aviation and shipping, Electric
Climate effects will likely include irreversible changes in some regions, especially ecosystems and ice sheets, though the phrase suggests certainty beyond reasonable debate, Climate
Cash may shrink in many advanced economies, but its complete disappearance globally is less likely due to privacy, outages, and inequality, Cash
Longevity research may unlock some genetic secrets, yet the chance that humans will live for centuries or forever is low, Longevity
